gloss: standing room only; standing audience; standing to watch

definitions.gloss: standing room only; standing audience; standing to watch
definitions.explanation: watching an event, performance, or movie while standing due to no available seats; or the standing area itself

examples.japanese: {立|た}ち{見|み}で{映画|えいが}を{観|み}た。
{立|た}ち{見席|みせき}でもいいからチケットがほしい。
examples.english: I want a ticket even if it's standing room only.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}のライブは{立|た}ち{見|み}でいっぱいだった。
examples.english: The popular concert was full of standing audience members.

notes:
FORMATION:
{立|た}つ (to stand) + {見|み}る (to watch) → watching while standing

USAGE CONTEXTS:
- Concerts and live performances (often the standard format)
- Theaters when sold out
- Sports events
- Movie theaters (rare, during peak times)

RELATED TERMS:
- {立|た}ち{見席|みせき} (standing room section)
- {立|た}ち{見|み}エリア (standing area)
- オールスタンディング (all-standing event)
- {指定席|していせき} (reserved seating)
- {自由席|じゆうせき} (unreserved seating)

VERB FORM:
- {立|た}ち{見|み}する (to watch while standing)
- {立|た}ち{見|み}になる (to end up standing)

RELATED:
- {着席|ちゃくせき} (seated, sitting down)
- {満席|まんせき} (full house, sold out)
